$comment: SDK conventions layered on top of the connector-js crypto-loan oracle. The oracle covers the flexible (v2) surface — the v1 fixed-term methods are deprecated (removed from upstream Postman in a6dbbbb) and stay on their existing hand-written schemas. Every entry needs a reason — this file is the review surface for deliberate divergences from the upstream OpenAPI typing.

numericStringFields.$comment: Oracle types these as string; the SDK's established convention (Wave 1, asserted by test/resources/Wave4Products.test.ts) transforms decimal-amount/rate strings to number at the parse boundary so consumers get numeric amounts. Applied by field name across all interfaces of this product.

flexibleIdFields.$comment: None for crypto-loan: no numeric id fields on this surface (loanCoin/collateralCoin/status are strings; rows are keyed by content, not id). Listed explicitly so the next rung knows the knob was considered.
